review: Request: Sol, who owns six harvested berries (item-2-sol-11, decay about 10.02, harvested at round 2), asked for a learnable, physically grounded method to reduce spoilage of owned edible berries with explicit material requirements and measurable outcomes, noting no preservation equipment and unowned nearby branches and stone, and asking that nothing be granted, assumed or altered by the request. World Agent decision: develop (learning 3) one passive, unheated air-dry food operation with a small paired trial, parameterized by an owned food stack, quantity, an accessible food-contact support, a position and a trial duration (default 10 rounds), with start, tend, inspect and stop as modes; a treated unit and an untreated reference split from the source with fractional quantities, decay, harvest time, ownership and provenance preserved; an actually obtained, stable, clean, dry, food-contact-safe support as a prerequisite, nothing granted, nearby unowned branches or stone not automatically suitable; study 3 rounds through learn, setup 1 round and 1 energy, each turning or repositioning 1 round and 0.2 energy, inspection reusing probe at its own cost without a duplicate fee; evaporation bounded by food water, heat and airflow under actual temperature, humidity, shelter and rain; spoilage reduction only from computed moisture; no nutrition created, decay never reversed; exposure plus observation with ordinary decay and no preservation bonus where the model gives no drying; a persistent trial record, a comparison at the end of the interval only from real observations, indeterminate without them, and interruption, removal, spoilage and death handled without refunds or automatic recovery; no experience grant. Registry check: the ex21 scope installs only the forest, open and expression foundations; none implements continuing food exposure. Implemented: a new package air-dry-food-trial@1 (scope long-ex21, handler long.air-dry-food-trial, one ability with learning 3 and no study energy) as a simplified but real mechanism over the installed general food water representation and the existing paid-work and escrow helpers. start (one round, 1 energy paid through workPay; all checks run before any charge) takes inputStackId (the actor's own unspoiled, untreated whole berry or root stack, by the shared ex19 whole-food check), quantity (whole units, default 1; the stack must hold 2 x quantity whole units), supportId and durationRounds (positive integer, default 10). It splits quantity treated and quantity reference units off the source through workAllocations and workReserve, so tenths, decay, harvest time and origin are kept and the source keeps its remainder (Sol's suggested trial leaves 4 of 6 berries); both units get the world food water record (berry 0.85 and root 0.75 water fraction, the representation's declared assumption). The treated units are laid unowned with foodWaterExpose (not prepared) over a ground footprint of 0.04 per unit at x,y within hand reach on the support; the reference stays carried and reserved, untreated, in ordinary handling. The support is either (a) the actor's own carried item, of which quantity whole units leave the carried load and are held in the trial record at the site while in use, so they cannot be picked up, or (b) an existing reachable object the world marks as a food surface and that no other person owns (the food then lies at its centre). The support rule, decided from represented facts: an own, unreserved, non-food material piece of at least one whole unit per food unit (shared ex19 piece check), non-toxic (toxicity 0), non-perishable (decay property 0), dry (its represented water fraction, or else the material moisture index, at most 0.1), rigid (contact-resistance index at least 8, the intact-stone threshold of the world's existing tool rules, and flexibility 0), not fractured and clean, meaning the world contact model shows no contamination and the item carries no processing, residue, marking, layer, wetness or other treatment record; ground placement must pass the representation's firm, unobstructed, unoccupied footprint check. Under this rule a gathered stone or flint unit qualifies; branches, bark, wood, sand and clay are not dry, resin is toxic, and nearby rocks and trees are not food surfaces. Sol can therefore walk to the nearest outcrop (start-2-stone, about 4.7 away), gather one stone for 2 energy, learn for 3 rounds and start for 1 energy; a throwaway check on the archived round-10 world confirmed this sequence and the refusals for the outcrop and a gathered branch. tend (one round, 0.2 energy, within hand reach of the treated units) turns them in place, which changes no represented food state, or, with x,y and an own support, moves the support and units together to a new checked ground point in reach, where the exposure restarts under that point's rain and temperature; an existing surface cannot be moved. inspect (within reach) calls the baseline probe observe on the treated units, which charges its own 0.2 energy and keeps its own record, and adds no fee; the trial then records, as an unverified personal record, elapsed rounds, quantities, decay of treated and reference units and their difference, visible shrinkage classed from the actual mass ratio, wetness, visible spoilage and rain rounds, stating that water is not measured. stop (one round, no energy) ends the trial. Unattended rounds charge nothing: the environment response records rain wetting, a partial or full removal by anyone, spoilage of either unit and the end of the interval. When durationRounds have elapsed since setup the trial ends as completed with a comparison built only from the recorded inspections (their values and event ids, handling and measurement limits, preservation and safety unverified), or as indeterminate when no inspection exists; spoilage of the treated units ends it as failed; removal, stop or death end it as interrupted. Every ending releases the carried reference once (dropped at the death position under death rules), withdraws the treated units' exposure in place and returns the support item to the world as an unowned stack at the site; recovery is by ordinary pickup at its own cost, and nothing is refunded. Events: air-dry-trial-placed, -tended, -inspected, -rained-on, -reduced, -removed, -spoiled, -reference-spoiled, -compared, -indeterminate, -stopped and -interrupted, plus the representation's preservation-progress; each carries view metadata (component ground-stack, operation passive_food_drying, source, treated and reference ids, support, position, quantity, start and update times, progress basis elapsed_exposure with elapsed and duration, visible condition, status exposed, completed, indeterminate, failed or interrupted, preservation unverified, evidence event ids); no new drawing is needed and no satisfaction source, reward or practice milestone is added. Physics and effects: the per-round exchange and decay are the existing representation, unchanged. In it whole, unprepared food neither evaporates nor absorbs vapour, so computed moisture never falls and no spoilage reduction can occur; rain on an uncovered surface adds 0.01 x rain x area water; decay continues at the ordinary temperature-dependent rate where each unit lies, never reset; nutrition and toxicity are unchanged; carried food exchanges no water. The tests show the treated unit's water equal to the reference in dry rounds and higher by exactly the rain received in wet rounds, with equal decay trajectories next to the actor, and conservation of berries and of the support across start, tending, inspection and every ending. Modeling assumptions: berry and root water fractions are the representation's 0.85 and 0.75, not measurements; one whole support unit offers the 0.04 single-layer footprint of one whole food unit (the earlier whole-food footprint, about 0.2 x 0.2), and the exposed area for rain is that footprint (or the whole object surface); the world represents no dirt on gathered material, so clean means no contamination, residue, marking or treatment record, and the support's own ground contact is not food contact; dryness uses the represented water fraction or the material moisture index with the threshold 0.1 (the driest represented class); rigidity uses the index-8 threshold and flexibility 0; a support held at the site is not drawn as a loose stack until it is returned; no contamination of exposed food, support-to-food water transfer, airflow term or latent-heat accounting is represented for whole food, so none is invented, and wind does not enter the whole-food exchange; turning has no represented consequence; a destructive sample is not offered because the probe's physical tests read fixed material properties that drying does not change and no squeeze or moisture reading is represented, so sampling would consume food without information; setup is one atomic round, so no partial setup or resume state exists; no safe-moisture threshold is applied because the represented rules give whole food no drying, so dried status is never reported. Reuse: the ex19 food-air-exposure-trial@1 factory is not extended, because this specification needs a committed obtained support, a turning and moving mode, probe-based inspection and an observation interval with a comparison, which would change nearly every behaviour and text of that package; instead the new module imports its shared helpers (airExposureUnsupported, airExposureTrack), the ex19 material contact helpers (ex19MaterialPiece, ex19MaterialContact, ex19MaterialWhole), the food water API (foodWaterExpose, foodWaterInitialize, foodWaterRead, foodWaterSurfaceArea, foodWaterWithdraw), the collective-work helpers, openRemember and the baseline open.probe handler, and leaves every ex19 and ex20 file untouched, so their packages, ability texts and behaviour are byte-identical and their tests pass. First release: no. The specification is self-consistent and implementable; it expressly anticipates exposure plus observation with ordinary decay and no preservation bonus when the model gives no drying, and the installed representation supplies the moisture, rain and decay rules, so this is a real mechanism with real costs, state changes and events, whose honest outcome for whole berries is no drying and no preservation.
